datasets.name: Autonomic Aging: A dataset to quantify changes of cardiovascular autonomic function during healthy aging
datasets.status: 20 real participant ECG/BP recordings processed; 19 preliminary ECG QC passes, 12 exploratory BRS outputs; 0 clinically validated biomarkers

datasets.name: Fantasia Database
signals: uncalibrated continuous noninvasive BP in 20 of 40 records
limitations: Uncalibrated BP unsuitable for absolute mmHg BRS without independent calibration
datasets.status: Four selected 5-minute annotated ECG segments benchmarked: F1=1.000 at 150ms tolerance; corrected timing medians 4/8/12/8ms; BRS remains unvalidated

datasets.name: Sleep Heart Health Study via National Sleep Research Resource
signals: polysomnography includes ECG; waveform availability must be linked to clinical data
outcomes: adjudicated CVD events in linked data
limitations: Verification of individual outcome-variable accessibility and ECG continuity required
Night-time/sleep measurement context differs from resting supine dataset
No verified beat-to-beat BP for the proposed BRS analysis
datasets.status: Candidate for prospective HRV outcome modelling, not yet approved/linked

datasets.name: MUSIC Sudden Cardiac Death in Chronic Heart Failure v1.0.1
limitations: Cohort has heart failure, not healthy ageing
Percutaneous revascularization does not confirm coronary stent
No continuous beat-to-beat BP waveforms for BRS
Approx 90.2 GB uncompressed total; metadata-only screening first
Event/censoring codes must be interpreted before survival analyses
Baseline HRV may be missing in non-Holter participants
datasets.status: Aggregate-only public metadata audit completed (2026-11-15): 992 participants; 587 with baseline SDNN/RMSSD; 176 prior percutaneous or combined revascularization (not confirmed stents); outcomes/censoring available but no predictive model fitted

datasets.name: MIDUS 2 Biomarker Project 2004-2009
outcomes: potential M2ID linkage to MIDUS mortality ICPSR 37237 through 2025, requires censoring and survivor roster
limitations: Per-stage time resolution and raw waveform availability not verified
Mortality file contains decedents and cannot alone supply denominator
Subject ID linkage and permitted analysis must be audited
datasets.status: Data source and challenge protocol confirmed, codebook and join feasibility outstanding

datasets.name: MIDUS core mortality 1995-2025 (ICPSR 37237 v7)
limitations: Contains known decedents, not full study population
Must link core survey for survivor status, ascertainment and censoring
datasets.status: Official file checked; no individual-level linkage attempted

datasets.name: Cerebromicrovascular Disease in Elderly with Diabetes
outcomes: 41 participants with two-year follow-up; verify released outcome variable availability
limitations: Subgroup definitions and waveform parsing need verification
datasets.status: Official PhysioNet source verified; pilot on selected records after data dictionary audit

datasets.name: Cerebral Vasoregulation in Elderly with Stroke
outcomes: cross-sectional movement, gait and balance responses; no confirmed long-term mortality linkage
datasets.status: Official waveform tasks verified; candidate for challenge-recovery pipeline QA
